thread:
sam_dev: starting canary deploy llm-router v6 -> enable feature flag llm_route_v6 at 03:00 UTC for 8% canary-global. plan: 8% -> 25% after 20m if health OK. note: v6 changes tokenizer post-processing for JSON outputs.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: deploy/llm-router/v6 -> canary-global. CI green, smoke ok. auto-ramp schedule active. link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/llm-router/6666
emma_pm: reminder: pin sessions sticky=true for canary to avoid cross-cohort noise and add release-note: "json-output-fixups". notify integrators channel.
oncall_jay: I'll watch error rates and downstream client rejections. threshold: client-json-errors >0.5% or error-rate >0.3% -> auto-hold.
deploy-bot: 03:05 UTC: ramp to 8% complete. telemetry: error-rate 0.05%, client-json-errors 0.1%.
sam_dev: seeing a small cluster of malformed JSON responses from v6 when tool-call output contains nested arrays. reproducing locally.
oncall_jay: 03:10 UTC: client-json-errors rising to 0.8% on canary-global, several service alerts from integrator tests. Initiating HOLD.
deploy-bot: Hold acknowledged. Ramp paused at 8%. snapshot saved. Rollback command: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-global
emma_pm: advice: soak 5m while dev triages, but prepare to rollback if >1% client-json-errors persists.
sam_dev: digging into post-tokenize sanitizer; likely edge-case escaping bug. will patch but prefer rollback for safety.
ops_kim: setting flag llm_route_v6=0 for canary cohort to stop new traffic: /flag set llm_route_v6 0 --cohort=canary-global --reason="json-output regression"
deploy-bot: Executing rollback: /deploy rollback llm-router --to-version v5 --scope canary-global --force
release_comm: updating release notes: "v6 canary paused/rolled back due to JSON output regression in tokenizer sanitizer; rollback executed; investigation ongoing."
oncall_jay: 03:17 UTC: rollback in progress, draining canary nodes. monitoring downstream client test suite.
sam_dev: after rollback traffic shift, client errors drop to baseline. saving failing payloads to repro. will open a PR for sanitizer fix and add extra unit tests for nested-array outputs.
emma_pm: action items: (1) dev to PR fix + unit tests, (2) QA to add integrator tests to CI, (3) schedule muted reattempt with stricter auto-hold and staged cohorts.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 03:25 UTC. Canary traffic restored to v5. No customer-facing incidents observed.
ops_kim: filed follow-up ticket and scheduled 1hr postmortem. keeping thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
